verses.text: The word of YHWH that came to Joel son of Pethuel:

segments.text: The word of YHWH that came to Joel son of Pethuel:

verses.text: Hear this, O elders, and give ear, all dwellers of the land. Has this come to be in your⁺ days, or even in the days of your⁺ fathers?

segments.text: Hear this, O elders, and give ear, all dwellers of the land. Has this come to be in your⁺ days, or even in the days of your⁺ fathers?

verses.text: Give account of it to your⁺ sons, and your⁺ sons to their sons, and their sons to the generation after.

segments.text: Give account of it to your⁺ sons, and your⁺ sons to their sons, and their sons to the generation after.

verses.text: The remainder of the devouring locust the swarming locust has eaten; and the remainder of the swarming locust the young locust has eaten; and the remainder of the young locust the destroying locust has eaten.

segments.text: The remainder of the devouring locust the swarming locust has eaten; and the remainder of the swarming locust the young locust has eaten; and the remainder of the young locust the destroying locust has eaten.

verses.text: Wake up, O drunkards, and weep; wail, all drinkers of wine, over the new wine, for it has been cut off from your⁺ mouth!

segments.text: Wake up, O drunkards, and weep; wail, all drinkers of wine, over the new wine, for it has been cut off from your⁺ mouth!

verses.text: For a nation has come up against My land, strong and without number; his teeth [are] the teeth of a lion, and the fangs of a fierce lion [are] unto him.

segments.text: For a nation has come up against My land, strong and without number; his teeth [are] the teeth of a lion, and the fangs of a fierce lion [are] unto him.

verses.text: He has set My vine to waste, and My fig tree to splinter; he has thoroughly stripped off the bark and thrown it away, its branches have become white.

segments.text: He has set My vine to waste, and My fig tree to splinter; he has thoroughly stripped off the bark and thrown it away, its branches have become white.

verses.text: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth over the husband of her youth.

segments.text: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth over the husband of her youth.

verses.text: The grain offering and the drink offering have been cut off from the house of YHWH; the priests mourn—those ministering to YHWH.

segments.text: The grain offering and the drink offering have been cut off from the house of YHWH; the priests mourn—those ministering to YHWH.

verses.text: The field is ruined, the land mourns; for the grain is ruined, the new wine is dried up, the oil languishes.

segments.text: The field is ruined, the land mourns; for the grain is ruined, the new wine is dried up, the oil languishes.

verses.text: Be ashamed, O farmers, wail, O vinedressers, over the wheat and over the barley, because the harvest of the field has perished.

segments.text: Be ashamed, O farmers, wail, O vinedressers, over the wheat and over the barley, because the harvest of the field has perished.

verses.text: The vine has withered and the fig tree has languished; the pomegranate, also the palm tree and the apple tree—all the trees of the field—have dried up. For the joy of the sons of man has withered away.

segments.text: The vine has withered and the fig tree has languished; the pomegranate, also the palm tree and the apple tree—all the trees of the field—have dried up. For the joy of the sons of man has withered away.

verses.text: Gird yourselves and lament, O priests; wail, [you] ministering before the altar. Come, lodge in sackcloth, [you] ministering before my God, for it is withheld from the house of your⁺ God—the grain offering and the drink offering.

segments.text: Gird yourselves and lament, O priests; wail, [you] ministering before the altar. Come, lodge in sackcloth, [you] ministering before my God, for it is withheld from the house of your⁺ God—the grain offering and the drink offering.

verses.text: Consecrate a fast, call a sacred assembly! Gather the elders [and] all those dwelling in the land [to] the house of YHWH your⁺ God, and cry out to YHWH.

segments.text: Consecrate a fast, call a sacred assembly! Gather the elders [and] all those dwelling in the land [to] the house of YHWH your⁺ God, and cry out to YHWH.

verses.text: Alas, for the day! For the day of YHWH [is] near, and as destruction from Shaddai, it shall come.

segments.text: Alas, for the day! For the day of YHWH [is] near, and as destruction from Shaddai, it shall come.

verses.text: Has not before our eyes the food been cut off—from the house of our God joy and rejoicing?

segments.text: Has not before our eyes the food been cut off—from the house of our God joy and rejoicing?

verses.text: The seed shrivels under their clods; the storehouses are desolate; the granaries are torn down, for the grain has withered.

segments.text: The seed shrivels under their clods; the storehouses are desolate; the granaries are torn down, for the grain has withered.

verses.text: How the cattle groan! The herds of cattle are perplexed, because [there is] no pasture unto them; even the flocks of the sheep suffer punishment.

segments.text: How the cattle groan! The herds of cattle are perplexed, because [there is] no pasture unto them; even the flocks of the sheep suffer punishment.

verses.text: To You, O YHWH, I call out, for fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and a flame has burned all the trees of the field.

segments.text: To You, O YHWH, I call out, for fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and a flame has burned all the trees of the field.

verses.text: Even the beasts of the field pant for You, for the channels of water have dried up, and fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

segments.text: Even the beasts of the field pant for You, for the channels of water have dried up, and fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
